posts.content_md:
I just noticed he joined our humble group on the 13th. I'm confused by the absence of old timers here. A comparison of our memberlist and rosters from the Lake Forest Symposia shows little correlation. They must all be working in the printing or computer industries. 

I wonder whatever happened to those who attended the RCA and MIT holography programs. Are *any* of them still making holograms? And the Shearwater beneficiaries? All three of these programs targeted *pictorial* holography, not technical. Just curious.

In any case, welcome Hans!

posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.content_md:
I have talked to many of the old school holographers. It has taken muchtime but we are winning them over. Kaveh has been a big help in requiting some of the old school people. I think Wales will help us get a few more. 

Thanks to Kaveh, Bob, Jeff and Hans many poeple who dismissed me years ago are starting to take us seriously. Everytime I get an email address of a holographer I extend a pesonal invintation the the forum. Sometimes I have a shot chat with them and they remember us, sometimes I don't get a return mail, but, sometimes we get a new holographer!

Please invite all you know!
